how.direct: accounts the public flow record (tla-flows/pnl) shows with stake left in a pool, each asked on the chain (all_staked_balances)
how.amp: every holder of the pool's amp token, from the chain's own list (bank denom_owners); each holder's LP = its part of the tokens outstanding × what the compounder has staked in the pool. amp_check gives, beside it, the tokens × the compounder's stated rate
how.check: per pool: the staking contract's total = the compounder's own stake + the direct stakers; what is not explained is "not_attributed" and is never spread over the others
how.names: a name is one the account registered; a label is one the address catalog has verified. Nothing else is named.
how.units: lp = LP tokens in the token's smallest unit; pct = share of the pool's staked LP
